name: processor
description: Kinesis consumer — writes latest vessel state to DynamoDB

scripts.package: npm run build && echo '{"type":"module"}' > dist/package.json && cd dist && npm install --omit=dev --silent @aws-sdk/client-dynamodb @aws-sdk/lib-dynamodb && mkdir -p ../../terraform/environments/dev/application/build && zip -qr ../../terraform/environments/dev/application/build/lambda.zip .
